# Eva AI by Innova Consulting Group

## About
Eva AI is an intelligent business assistant designed for tax consultants, lawyers, and business advisors. Powered by advanced AI technology, Eva provides expert-level answers across 300+ jurisdictions in 6 languages.

## Key Features
- Tax & Offshore Consulting: Knowledge of 300+ jurisdictions
- Legal Research: Instant corporate law answers
- Lead Qualification: 24/7 automated pre-qualification
- Document Analysis: AI-powered contract review
- Multilingual: EN, RU, UK, DE, FR, ES
